subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘mould soft gel’ is written as ‘8 6 4’, ‘gel is not hard’ is written as ‘pr kc 8 3’ and ‘hard is grey mould’ is written as ‘kc 3 4 9’. How will ‘grey soft’ be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e933e8cf3e9f38a52e42986f36e0533e49055d3ec6f85117f6fd62dc90b4563.png] 

Here, Grey will be coded as 9,

Soft will be coded as 6.

So, ‘grey soft’ will be coded as 9 6.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
